cv.name: Rodrigo Salcedo Ibarra
cv.headline: Key Account Manager | Electronics Manufacturing Services | Nearshoring
cv.summary: Key account manager with six years managing OEM customers for electronics manufacturing in Jalisco. Experienced with US customers moving production to Mexico, quoting, and coordinating engineering and planning teams for new product introductions.

experience.title: Key Account Manager
bullets: Manage four US industrial and medical OEM accounts worth US$38M in annual revenue
Grew the largest account by 27% through two nearshoring transfers from Asia
Lead quarterly business reviews and coordinate NPI with engineering and production
Prepare quotes and cost breakdowns together with the pricing team

experience.title: Account Manager
bullets: Handled 12 mid-sized accounts for PCB assembly, including forecasting and order follow-up
Resolved quality escalations with customers and the quality department

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Supported US customers with shipment tracking and IMMEX documentation

skills: Quoting and cost breakdowns (BOM, labor, overhead)
